name: Health & Respawn
description: Players can take damage and respawn. Works with: Game Flow, Trigger Area.

drivenBy.rule: Nothing takes hit points by itself — the server calls damage() wherever the harm happens, and this item does the dying and the respawn.
drivenBy.next: Press New script below, write that inside the isServer() block it comes with, and import damage from the health.ts beside this item's own script.

changelog.notes: Initial release: hit points the server owns in game.state.health, a respawn point picked in the inspector, a "die below height" death plane, and a damage() other server code calls.
The placed item's Script card now shows the damage() call that takes hit points, under its respawn settings.
